bounds: Five class members, each the last member of a `pattern` class `[a<member>]` on a planner action parameter: a plain character, a literal hyphen, a literal caret, a closing bracket and the range b-c; two llama.cpp grammar parsers: the elizaOS/llama.cpp fork at the plugins/plugin-local-inference/native/llama.cpp submodule pin and the copy bundled in llama-cpp-capacitor 0.1.5. The implementation check builds the grammar with buildPlannerActionGrammarStrict, compiles test/fixtures/llama-grammar-loader.cpp against each parser's llama-grammar.cpp, loads the whole grammar, and matches the compiled class against a member and a non-member string. A class with `"`, a backslash or a control character keeps jsonstring and is never compiled, so those members are not modeled. A member in another class position, class shorthands inside a class (`[\d.]`), other llama.cpp versions and model sampling are outside this model. Safety is unconditional.
